answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a oasis as the anchor of the cost.
